title: populus × canadensis var. virginiana
intro: Populus × canadensis var. virginiana, commonly known as Eastern Cottonwood or Virginian Poplar, is a deciduous tree native to Eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Populus × canadensis var. virginiana are attributed to its ability to act as a demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
